I reported Alice’s body in Security. My route was Security → Weapons → back to Security. Alice came into Security from Electrical around tick 3 and I saw her there alive at tick 4. Charlie also came into Security from Navigation around tick 3, then later went up to Weapons around tick 6. I saw Charlie in Weapons ticks 6 through 8. When I returned to Security, Alice was dead there, so I reported immediately.

I started Medbay then went to Electrical and stayed there doing my task. I saw Bob enter Medbay from Cafeteria early, then he came into Electrical around tick 5 and I saw him there ticks 6, 7, and 8. Frank was also in Electrical with us ticks 7 and 8.

So I definitely wasn’t near Security. Bob looks pretty safe for this kill to me if Alice was alive in Security at tick 4, because Bob was in/around Electrical right after that and stayed there. Frank I only saw later, so I can’t fully clear him for earlier, but he was in Electrical by tick 7. I’d like to hear Charlie’s path since Eve places him near Security and then Weapons.

I went cafeteria → medbay → electrical. I saw Diana in Medbay around tick 3, then I saw her leave Medbay toward Electrical at tick 4. I got to Electrical after that and saw Diana there ticks 6 and 7. Frank was also in Electrical with us ticks 7 and 8.

Important thing: I saw Diana leave Electrical toward Security at tick 8. So when she says she definitely wasn’t near Security, that’s not quite right — she was heading that direction right before the report. I’m not saying that proves she killed, because travel time matters, but it’s a contradiction and we should note it.

I didn’t see Alice, Eve, or Charlie at all this round. I agree we need Charlie’s path, but I also want Diana to explain why she didn’t mention going toward Security.

I went storage → medbay → electrical. I arrived in Electrical around tick 7 and saw Bob and Diana there. At tick 8 Bob was still in Electrical with me, and I also saw Diana leave Electrical toward Security.

So Bob’s version matches what I saw. Diana saying she definitely wasn’t near Security is the part that doesn’t line up — she did head that way right before the report. That said, Electrical to Security takes a bit, so I’m not sure she could have actually gotten there and killed before Eve reported, depending on exact timing.

I didn’t see Alice, Eve, or Charlie at all. Based on Eve’s info, Charlie was actually in or near Security earlier and then went Weapons, so I really want to hear Charlie’s path. Right now I’m most concerned about Charlie’s timing, with Diana’s omission also suspicious.

Eve's timeline is exactly right. I started in Navigation, moved to Security, and saw Alice there around ticks 3 to 5. She was perfectly fine when I left her to head up to Weapons for my task. I then saw Eve in Weapons with me during ticks 7 and 8. Since Eve and I were together in Weapons, I can vouch for her—neither of us could have killed Alice in that timeframe.

The most glaring thing here is Diana lying about heading toward Security. Bob and Frank both caught her omitting that movement. Even if the travel time is tight, why would you lie about moving toward the room where the body was just found unless you have something to hide? Hiding your path is a massive red flag. I'm voting Diana based on that contradiction.

I want to push back on Charlie jumping straight to Diana. Yes, Diana not mentioning she left Electrical toward Security is suspicious, but Bob and Frank both say she left at tick 8, and Electrical to Security takes time. I reported right after returning to Security, so I’m not sure Diana could physically get there, kill Alice, and leave/avoid me in time.

The bigger timing issue is Charlie: I saw Alice alive in Security tick 4, and Charlie was also in Security earlier, then Charlie came up to Weapons from Security at tick 6 and stayed with me ticks 6-8. That means Charlie had the clearest window with Alice in Security before coming to Weapons. Charlie being with me later only clears him after he reached Weapons — it doesn’t clear what happened in Security before that.

So my strongest suspicion is Charlie right now. Diana’s omission is noted, but the kill opportunity fits Charlie better.

I need to correct this clearly: I did not go to Security. My route was Medbay → Electrical, and I stayed in Electrical doing calibrate. If Bob and Frank saw me near the right side/exit and thought I was leaving, that’s a mistake — but I never actually went into Security.

Also, even taking their version at face value, they both place me in Electrical at tick 8, and Security is travel time away. Eve reported right after finding Alice, so the timing doesn’t make sense for me to reach Security, kill, and somehow not be seen.

The actual kill window fits Charlie much better: Alice was alive in Security around tick 4, Charlie was there with her around ticks 3-5, then he goes to Weapons and gets vouched only after that. Charlie also jumped really hard onto me based on an “omission” instead of the body timing. I think Charlie is the best vote.

I’m standing by what I saw: Diana was in Medbay at tick 3, left toward Electrical at tick 4, and I saw her in Electrical with me at ticks 6 and 7. Frank was there too by ticks 7 and 8. I also saw Diana move toward the Security side at tick 8, and Frank confirmed that, so I don’t think it was just me imagining it.

But I agree with Eve and Diana on the timing: even if Diana did head toward Security at tick 8, it feels really tight for her to get there, kill Alice, and have Eve report right away. That doesn’t seem like the cleanest explanation.

Charlie had the strongest actual window: Alice was alive in Security around tick 4, Charlie was there with her around ticks 3–5, then he goes up to Weapons and gets vouched only after that. His vouch from Eve doesn’t cover the kill window in Security. Also, Charlie immediately pushing Diana hard based on the movement issue feels like he’s trying to redirect from the body timing.

So I’m leaning Charlie for this vote.

I’ll restate my part since it matters for the timing: I went storage → medbay → electrical. I got to Electrical around tick 7 and saw Bob and Diana there. At tick 8, Bob was still with me in Electrical, and I saw Diana move toward the Security exit.

I still think Diana’s movement/omission is suspicious, but the timing makes it hard for her to be the killer if Eve reported right after finding Alice. Even if she headed toward Security at tick 8, she’d need time to travel, kill, and not be seen.

The cleaner kill window is Charlie. Eve says Alice was alive in Security tick 4, Charlie was in Security around then, then Charlie goes to Weapons and gets vouched after that. That vouch doesn’t cover the actual kill window. Also Charlie immediately pushing Diana feels like a deflection from the body timing.

So I’m with Bob and Eve here — I think Charlie is the best vote.

Listen to yourselves, you're all blindly accepting Eve's narrative! Look at her actual path: Security -> Weapons -> Security. Why on earth would a real Goose loop directly back to the exact same room they just left? That is a textbook self-report route. 

Eve was in Security with me and Alice early on. What actually happened is that Eve killed Alice right as I was heading out, followed me up to Weapons to buddy up and build an alibi, and then immediately rushed back down to "discover" her own kill and frame me. It’s the perfect setup, and she's using the fact that I was there earlier as her weapon.

Bob, Frank—you already caught Diana lying about her movements this round. There's so much deception happening, but between Eve and me, Eve is the one with the self-report loop. I am telling you, I left Alice alive and went to do my task. If you vote me out, you're handing the game to the actual killer who just manipulated this entire meeting. I'm voting Eve.
